channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: UAE calls for de-escalation between Kabul, Islamabad
item.description: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has expressed concern over renewed military clashes between Afghanistan and Pakistan, urging de-escalation between the two countries.

item.title: Kabul-Islamabad tensions: Trump says he maintains good relations with Pakistan
item.description: US President Donald Trump, responding to recent tensions between Afghanistan and Pakistan, stated that he could intervene if necessary but emphasised that he has “very good” relations with Islamabad.

item.title: Drone flights banned across Pakistan
item.description: Pakistan has imposed a ban on all drone operations across the country following retaliatory strikes by Afghanistan, a media report said on Saturday.

item.title: US, Israel launch “pre‑emptive” attacks on Iran
item.description: The Israeli Ministry of Defence announced on Saturday that it had carried out a “pre‑emptive missile strike” against Iran, media reports said.

item.title: US, Israel launch strikes on Iran; Tehran vows response
item.description: US President Donald Trump says the United States has begun “major combat operations” in Iran, while Tehran is preparing a crushing response.

item.title: Iran launches first wave of missile strikes on Israel: IRGC
item.description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) announced on Saturday it had launched the first wave of missile strikes against Israel in response to attacks by the United States and Israel.

item.title: Iran launches missile strikes on 4 US bases in Gulf region
item.description: Iran carried out missile attacks targeting four United States military bases in Qatar, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Bahrain on Saturday.

item.title: Sugar, flour, gold prices up in Kabul
item.description: The prices of Indian sugar, Kazakh flour and Arabic gold surged, while cooking oil, fuel and Russian gold declined in outgoing week in Kabul, market sources said on Saturday.

item.title: Iran declares 40 days of mourning after Khamenei’s death
item.description: Following the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in attacks carried out by the United States and Israel, forty days of national mourning and seven days of public holiday have been declared in Iran.

item.title: Antonio Guterres condemns US-Israel attacks on Iran
item.description: United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has condemned the recent attacks by the United States and Israel on Iran.
